client: Kettlewell Support Co.

text: Noor was solid to work with and kept the project moving without a lot of hand-holding. Communication was generally clear, though we did have to ask for a bit more detail on a few updates than we expected. The ticket routing model did what we needed, and the jump in median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes was a big improvement. Overall, a dependable freelancer for this kind of work.
